name: UART Bluetooth Serial Module
description: Like a wireless serial cable! Links your phone or computer to the Arduino using Bluetooth radio.
realWorldAnalogy: Like a wireless serial cable! Links your phone or computer to the Arduino using Bluetooth radio.
wiringGuidance: Connect VCC (Red) to 5V, GND (Dark Slate) to GND, TXD (Purple) to Pin 2, and RXD (Purple) through a voltage divider to Pin 3.
commonMistakes: Connecting Arduino 5V TX directly to HC-05 RXD without a voltage divider.
Leaving Bluetooth connected to pins 0 and 1 while uploading sketches.

miniExperiment.title: Bluetooth Serial Echo
miniExperiment.circuit: VCC to 5V, GND to GND, TX to Pin 2, RX via divider to Pin 3.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Messages sent from a Bluetooth terminal smartphone app appear in the Serial Monitor.
